name: @singularity-layer/cli
description: Singularity developer CLI — deploy paid endpoints (Processors) on the Singularity Cloud Network

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build

//: PACKAGE NAME vs COMMAND NAME are deliberately different. The bare `singularity` name on npm
belongs to someone else, so the package is scoped — matching the rest of the family. The BIN
is still `singularity`, so users type what they expect.
esbuild is a RUNTIME dependency, not a build-time one: the CLI bundles the publisher's processor
for them. That is what makes npm packages and multi-file TypeScript processors possible at all —
bundling happens on the publisher's machine, because running `npm install` on our infrastructure
would mean executing arbitrary postinstall scripts on a box holding platform credentials.
THIS REPO IS PUBLIC ON PURPOSE. People hand this CLI a Solana keypair, so the code that signs with
it should be readable, and npm provenance — which attests the tarball was built from a named commit
by the release workflow — is only available for public sources.
This is the DEVELOPER CLI: one command, subcommands per product. It is deliberately NOT:
• `sgl`      — the Rust node-operator daemon. Different audience and runtime, and its
releases are hash-allowlisted, so coupling would slow both.
• `sglcode`  — the agentic coding CLI, a product in its own right.
The rule that stops sprawl: new capabilities become SUBCOMMANDS here, never new binaries.
